description: ZP-MC-A-13012 is the drawing identifier for connector adapter component in AutomationDirect's ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors collection. A connector adapter provides the documented mechanical or connection interface between selected components. Its outline does not prove that unrelated connector systems are compatible.

For example, in a connection assembly using a separately scheduled adapter, use the ZP-MC-A-13012 reference to coordinate both adjoining interfaces and assembly access. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as Enclosures and Wiring/ZIPport Multi-Wire Connectors/ZP-MC-A-13012.dwg for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
